startups.why: Lithium can't cover multi-day storage. Cheap iron chemistry could make renewables firm power.

startups.why: Ageing grid hardware is the bottleneck for EV and data-centre load growth.

startups.why: Retrofitting the panels already installed is faster than building new solar farms.

startups.name: Kilnless
startups.why: Industrial heat is about a fifth of global emissions, and almost none of it is electrified yet.

startups.name: Meterly
